headline: Namibia President Urges Domestic Businesses to Target $42 Billion Dangote Project
summary: President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah urged Namibian entrepreneurs to build capacity to compete for subcontracts under a proposed N$42 billion ($2.3 billion) Dangote tank farm and regional pipeline project at Walvis Bay.
why: Dangote Group's planned midstream oil and fuel storage network represents a substantial infrastructure proposal for Southern Africa.

impacts.name: Namibia
impacts.why: The $2.3 billion Dangote fuel terminal and pipeline project could boost local logistics and subcontracting.
